title: Khus Sarbat
description: Khus Sarbat (Vetiver Syrup) is a classic summer beverage prepared from the aromatic roots of Khus grass (Vetiveria zizanioides). This classical formulation acts as a natural coolant. Prevents sunstrokes. Relieves burning urination. Prevents dehydration. Soothes irritated stomach.
dosage: 30–40 ml mixed in cold water or soda water
